_source: myCatalogOrders -> MyCatalogOrdersResponse { success, message, error, metadata, data: [CatalogOrderEntity!] }. CatalogOrderEntity introspected live: activatedAt, activityLogs, autoRenew!, catalogItem, catalogTier, createdAt!, fulfillmentKind!, id!, invoices, renewsAt, status:CatalogOrderStatus!, updatedAt!, user. The handler loads catalogItem and catalogTier; activityLogs, invoices and user are not loaded and are null on the wire. CatalogOrderStatus introspected live has six members: active | cancelled | completed | in_progress | pending_payment | suspended. THE in_progress ROW IS THE SOURCE OF THE 'ONE STANDING UP' STATE - an app that is paid for and not yet finished being built - and it is drawn with NO action, which needs no new row shape at all because identity-kind-status-action-row.action is already optional and its own why states the reason verbatim: a resource mid-provision has nothing anybody may do to it. activatedAt is null on that row and that is what makes it honest.
